```{r, include=FALSE}
library(splines)
library(ggplot2)
library(mgcv)
library(caret)
```

# Duomenų padalijimas

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df$ProductRelated_Duration, p = 0.75, list = FALSE)
train_df <- df[train_idx, ]
test_df <- df[-train_idx, ]
```

# Spline modeliai

```{r}
# df yra kiek mazgų turės spline
df_values <- 3:15
cv_folds  <- createFolds(train_df$ProductRelated_Duration, k = 5)

# Geriausio df parinkimas per kryžminę patikrą (B-Spline)
bs_cv_rmse <- sapply(df_values, function(d) {
  fold_rmse <- sapply(cv_folds, function(idx) {
    tr <- train_df[-idx, ]
    val <- train_df[idx, ]
    m <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ bs(ProductRelated, df = d,
                 Boundary.knots = c(0, max(df$ProductRelated) * 10)) +
                 Administrative + PageValues + VisitorType + Weekend, data = tr)
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = val)
    sqrt(mean((val$ProductRelated_Duration - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  mean(fold_rmse)
})

best_bs_df <- df_values[which.min(bs_cv_rmse)]
cat("Geriausias B-Spline df:", best_bs_df, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Geriausio df parinkimas per kryžminę patikrą (Natural Spline)
ns_cv_rmse <- sapply(df_values, function(d) {
  fold_rmse <- sapply(cv_folds, function(idx) {
    tr <- train_df[-idx, ]
    val <- train_df[idx, ]
    m <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ ns(ProductRelated, df = d,
                 Boundary.knots = c(0, max(df$ProductRelated) * 10)) +
                 Administrative + PageValues + VisitorType + Weekend, data = tr)
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = val)
    sqrt(mean((val$ProductRelated_Duration - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  mean(fold_rmse)
})

best_ns_df <- df_values[which.min(ns_cv_rmse)]
cat("Geriausias Natural Spline df:", best_ns_df, "\n")
```

```{r}
bs_model <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ bs(Administrative_Duration, df = 3), data = train_df)
summary(bs_model)
```

```{r}
ns_model <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ ns(ProductRelated, df = best_ns_df), data = train_df)

summary(ns_model)
```

# GAM modelis

```{r}
# gam_model <- gam(ProductRelated_duration ~ 
#                    s(Administrative) + 
#                    s(Administrative_Duration) + 
#                    s(Informational) + 
#                    s(Informational_Duration) +
#                    s(PageValues) + 
#                    s(BounceRates)+
#                    s(ExitRates) +
#                    Month + TrafficType + SpecialDay +
#                  VisitorType + Weekend, 
#                  data = train_df, method = "REML")

# R-sq.(adj) =   0.48   Deviance explained = 48.5%
# TRAIN RMSE: 1410.4 
# TEST  RMSE: 1685.06 
# 
# TRAIN MAE: 848.67 seconds
# TEST  MAE: 918.06 seconds

gam_model <- gam(log1p(ProductRelated_Duration) ~
                   s(Administrative) +
                   s(Administrative_Duration) +
                   s(Informational) +
                   s(Informational_Duration) +
                   s(PageValues) +
                   s(BounceRates)+
                   s(ExitRates) +
                   Month + TrafficType + SpecialDay +
                 VisitorType + Weekend,
                 data = train_df, method = "REML")

# R-sq.(adj) =  0.485   Deviance explained = 48.9%
# TRAIN RMSE: 1585.81 
# TEST  RMSE: 1827.46 
# 
# TRAIN MAE: 793.15 seconds
# TEST  MAE: 850.64 seconds
```

```{r}
summary(gam_model)
```

```{r}
gam.check(gam_model)
```

```{r}
train_preds_log <- predict(gam_model, newdata = train_df)
test_preds_log  <- predict(gam_model, newdata = test_df)

train_preds_real <- expm1(train_preds_log)
test_preds_real  <- expm1(test_preds_log)

train_actual_real <- train_df$ProductRelated_Duration
test_actual_real  <- test_df$ProductRelated_Duration

rmse_train <- sqrt(mean((train_actual_real - train_preds_real)^2))
rmse_test  <- sqrt(mean((test_actual_real - test_preds_real)^2))

mae_train <- mean(abs(train_actual_real - train_preds_real))
mae_test  <- mean(abs(test_actual_real - test_preds_real))

cat("TRAIN RMSE:", round(rmse_train, 2), "\n")
cat("TEST  RMSE:", round(rmse_test, 2), "\n\n")
cat("TRAIN MAE:", round(mae_train, 2), "seconds\n")
cat("TEST  MAE:", round(mae_test, 2), "seconds\n")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = data.frame(actual = test_actual_real, pred = test_preds_real), 
       aes(x = actual, y = pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Test Set: Predicted vs. Actual Duration",
       x = "Actual Duration (sec)",
       y = "Predicted Duration (sec)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Lokalios regresijos modelis

```{r}
target <- "ProductRelated_Duration"

X_train <- train_df |> select(-all_of(target)) |> select(where(is.numeric))
y_train <- train_df[[target]]

span_values   <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)
pcaComp_values <- 1:3

grid_results <- expand.grid(span = span_values, pcaComp = pcaComp_values)
grid_results$RMSE <- NA

for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid_results))) {
  s  <- grid_results$span[i]
  pc <- grid_results$pcaComp[i]
  
  fold_rmse <- sapply(cv_folds, function(idx) {
    
    X_tr  <- X_train[-idx, ]
    y_tr  <- y_train[-idx]
    X_val <- X_train[idx, ]
    y_val <- y_train[idx]
    
    # PCA 
    preproc <- preProcess(X_tr, method = c("center", "scale", "pca"),
                          pcaComp = pc)
    
    X_tr_pca  <- predict(preproc, X_tr)  |> mutate(!!target := y_tr)
    X_val_pca <- predict(preproc, X_val)
    
    # LOESS 
    pc_cols      <- paste0("PC", 1:pc)
    loess_formula <- as.formula(paste(target, "~", paste(pc_cols, collapse = " + ")))

    m <- loess(loess_formula, data = X_tr_pca, span = s)

    pred <- predict(m, newdata = X_val_pca)
    
    # NA tvarkymas
    na_idx <- is.na(pred)
    if (any(na_idx)) {
      X_val_clamped <- X_val_pca
      for (var in pc_cols) {
        X_val_clamped[[var]] <- pmin(X_val_pca[[var]], max(X_tr_pca[[var]], na.rm = TRUE))
      }
      pred[na_idx] <- predict(m, newdata = X_val_clamped)[na_idx]
    }
    
    sqrt(mean((y_val - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  
  grid_results$RMSE[i] <- mean(fold_rmse)
}

best_row  <- grid_results[which.min(grid_results$RMSE), ]
best_span    <- best_row$span
best_pcaComp <- best_row$pcaComp

cat("Geriausias span:   ", best_span, "\n")
cat("Geriausias pcaComp:", best_pcaComp, "\n")
cat("RMSE:              ", round(best_row$RMSE, 4), "\n")



ggplot(grid_results, aes(x = span, y = RMSE, color = factor(pcaComp))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "Span", y = "RMSE", color = "pcaComp") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
preproc <- preProcess(X_train, method = c("center", "scale", "pca"),
                          pcaComp = best_pcaComp)

X_tr_pca  <- predict(preproc, X_train)  |> mutate(!!target := y_train)

X_test_pca <- predict(preproc, test_df)

loess_model <- loess(ProductRelated_Duration ~ PC1, data = X_tr_pca, span = best_span)
```

# Modelių palyginimas

```{r}
eval_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
  r2 <- cor(actual, predicted)^2
  mae <- mean(abs(actual - predicted))
  c(RMSE = round(rmse, 2), R2 = round(r2, 4), MAE = round(mae, 2))
}

# Jei po prognozavimo atsiranda NA reikšmės, faktorių reikšmes reikia pakeisti į mokymo duomenų intervalą
clamp_predict <- function(model, newdata, train_data) {
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata)
  na_idx <- is.na(pred)
  if (any(na_idx)) {
    num_vars <- names(Filter(is.numeric, train_data))
    newdata_clamped <- newdata
    for (var in num_vars) {
      rng <- range(train_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      newdata_clamped[[var]] <- pmax(pmin(newdata[[var]], rng[2]), rng[1])
    }
    pred[na_idx] <- predict(model, newdata = newdata_clamped)[na_idx]
  }
  pred
}

bs_pred <- clamp_predict(bs_model, test_df, train_df)
ns_pred <- clamp_predict(ns_model, test_df, train_df)
gam_pred <- clamp_predict(gam_model, test_df, train_df)
loess_pred <- clamp_predict(loess_model, X_test_pca, X_tr_pca)

rezultatai <- data.frame(
  Modelis = c("B-Spline", "Natural Spline", "GAM", "Lokalioji regresija"),
  rbind(
    eval_metrics(test_df$ProductRelated_Duration, bs_pred),
    eval_metrics(test_df$ProductRelated_Duration, ns_pred),
    eval_metrics(test_df$ProductRelated_Duration, gam_pred),
    eval_metrics(test_df$ProductRelated_Duration, loess_pred)
  )
)

knitr::kable(rezultatai,
             col.names = c("Modelis", "RMSE", "R²", "MAE"),
             caption   = "Modelių palyginimas testavimo aibėje")
```

```{r}
AIC(bs_model, ns_model, gam_model)
```
